text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin has been trying to master<n>a more
controlled running style, but<n>it's just not working
out, and she's<n>fallen into a slump.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I suggest we forget about it for now,<n>but she won't
have it. She's<n>determined to show her family that
she can stand tall after a race.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho arrives,<n>and Ines Fujin
makes a rare<n>work-related mistake.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Although she takes care of the issue<n>and nothing
big comes of it, she's left<n>shaken. For now, the
most I can do is<n>lend her my full support.
